items.title: Blog Driving consistency in ADHD, autism and mental health care: What does Professor Fonagy’s review propose? 12/10/2026 IHPN welcomes Professor Peter Fonagy’s review into ADHD, autism and mental health, including its call for consistent quality standards, stronger oversight and better data across all providers. We explore what the recommendations mean for independent healthcare, and why harnessing high-quality provider capacity will be essential to improving access and reducing waiting times. Read more

items.title: Blog Stop planning for capacity. Start using it. 29/09/2026 Governments across Britain are developing ambitious plans to tackle waiting lists, but patients need action now. Read more

items.title: Blog Zero-hours contract reforms must protect workers without compromising patient care 27/08/2026 IHPN supports stronger protections for workers but is calling for zero-hours contract reforms to reflect the realities of healthcare delivery.
